questions.stem: Many famous ______ (discover) changed our life.
questions.analysis: many后接可数名词复数，discover的名词形式discovery，变复数为discoveries

questions.stem: Tom is a slow ______ (learn), but he never gives up.
questions.analysis: learner表示学习者，a slow learner 一个学得慢的学习者

questions.stem: ______ (collect) stamps is my favourite hobby.
questions.analysis: 动名词作句子主语，谓语用单数

questions.stem: A good eating habit keeps the ______ (balance) of our body.
questions.analysis: the + 名词，balance此处作名词，意为平衡

questions.stem: We need to develop good study ______ (strategy).
questions.analysis: study strategies 学习方法，用复数表示一类事物

questions.stem: Don't put off ______ (practise) your oral English.
questions.analysis: 固定搭配put off doing sth. 推迟做某事

questions.stem: The story is ______ (base) on a real event.
questions.analysis: 固定短语 be based on 以……为基础

questions.stem: ______ (memorize) new words takes lots of time.
questions.analysis: 动名词作主语，谓语动词用单数takes

questions.stem: The little girl listened carefully and then ______ (retell) the whole story.
questions.analysis: and连接并列谓语，前面listened是过去式，retell也要变过去式retold

questions.stem: Each of the students ______ (recognize) the famous scientist.
questions.analysis: each of +名词复数，谓语动词用单数形式

questions.stem: The ______ (physics) dream is to make a new invention.
questions.analysis: 名词所有格physicist's，表示物理学家的（梦想）

questions.stem: We can get many learning ______ (material) from the Internet.
questions.analysis: many后面加可数名词复数materials

questions.stem: We should use our time ______ (efficient).
questions.analysis: 副词efficiently修饰动词use

questions.stem: There are lots of books on these ______ (shelf).
questions.analysis: these后面用复数，shelf变复数shelves，f改v加es

questions.stem: ______ (sad) filled her heart when she lost her pet.
questions.analysis: 句子缺少主语，需要名词sadness（悲伤）

questions.stem: The notes remind us ______ (keep) a good habit.
questions.analysis: 固定搭配 remind sb. to do sth. 提醒某人做某事

questions.stem: He positioned ______ (he) near the window to get fresh air.
questions.analysis: 反身代词himself，表示他自己

questions.stem: Two new ______ (mall) will be built in our city.
questions.analysis: two后面接可数名词复数malls

questions.stem: My parents ______ (full) support my decision.
questions.analysis: 副词fully修饰动词support

questions.stem: People in the past died from ______ (wound) because of no medicine.
questions.analysis: 此处泛指伤口，用复数wounds

questions.stem: It is an ______ (inspire) speech and everyone is moved.
questions.analysis: -ing形容词修饰事物speech，意为令人鼓舞的

questions.stem: ______ (science) research needs lots of patience.
questions.analysis: 形容词scientific修饰名词research，科学的研究

questions.stem: Without useful ______ (guide), teenagers may lose their way.
questions.analysis: guidance名词，意为指导

questions.stem: Having a ______ (grow) mindset helps us face difficulties.
questions.analysis: growth mindset 固定表达：成长型思维

questions.stem: American English has some ______ (different) from British English.
questions.analysis: some后接名词复数differences，表示不同之处

questions.stem: The ______ (village) helped us find the way to the ancient town.
questions.analysis: villager村民，此处可用复数表示村民们

questions.stem: You can seldom see ______ (lorry) running in the city centre.
questions.analysis: lorry是可数名词，此处用复数lorries表一类事物

questions.stem: He is ______ (hunger) for knowledge.
questions.analysis: 固定搭配 be hungry for 渴望……

questions.stem: We ______ (admire) those ancient Chinese people who built the Great Wall.
questions.analysis: 主语we，一般现在时，动词用原形admire

questions.stem: We are amazed at the ______ (wise) of ancient people.
questions.analysis: the + 名词，wisdom名词：智慧
